segments.summary: Reviewed the three owner maps for Goal Runtime, semantic audit closure, and Plans-to-code handoff. Authority boundaries are generally explicit; backlink and cross-document reference-scan requirements lack dedicated falsification surfaces.

Reviewed PRD/Planning Wizard migration, native discovery, and provider-update routing. Each map expresses substantive semantic or runtime proof requirements that are not bound to behavior-specific validation or receipts.

Reviewed miscellaneous History/Vision/Teach routing, four-lane feature intake, and Free Models routing. The History/Vision/Teach unit contradicts its compiled state, while Free Models lacks cross-owner lifecycle proof; the four-lane intake keeps lineage authority explicit.

Reviewed containerized-host and external-repo import owner maps. Security-sensitive host lifecycle behavior and closed-world import completeness lack bound executable proofs, and 0PI-066 contains a duplicate implementation surface.
